description: Flom Aktsomhetsoner Drøbak is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Frogn kommune. Beregnede flomsoner for 200-årsflom (inklusive 40% klimapåslag) for Raskebekken i Drøbak. Det er forutsatt at alle rør, kulverter og sluk er tilstoppet. For å ta høyde for usikkerhet i beregningene, er det også laget flomsone med sikkerhetsmargin for vannstigning. Sikkerhetsmarginen er satt til 0,5 meter i henhold til anbefaling gitt av NVE. Coverage: Frogn kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Frogn kommune. Its keywords include Det offentlige kartgrunnlaget, Samfunnssikkerhet, Frogn kommune. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2018-12-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
